draw.method: own script: shippable = candidate likely groups whose category is not in GROUP_HOLD_CATS (153); 30 groups by largest remainder over categories (window-regulator 18, side-mirrors 8, climate-control 3, gauge-cluster 1), per category rng.sample of the id-sorted list, categories in name order; then rng.sample(30) of the remaining 123 id-sorted groups; per pair seeker = rng.choice(expanded vehicle-years), donor = rng.choice(other vehicle-years with >=1 lot car) else any other.

span.plus_minus_one_month: no verdict changes at 07/(N-1)-08/N or 09/(N-1)-06/N. Edge-sensitive at two months: 5af5348a13 and 6201d377aa (window ends 08/1993, Altima 1993 ungated), e6dd47a01e pair 20 (window from 07/1996, Altima/Stanza 1997 ungated), 8d55de172f pair 11 (07/2001 start).
